lines.en: Spent from all the ups and downs and ins and outs, the time has come for me to once again reflect on the day while reminiscing about all of the sex I had.
lines.zh: 经历了这么多的起起落落、进进出出,我已经筋疲力尽,是时候再一次回味这一天,同时回忆起我经历过的所有性爱了。

lines.en: These festive laments are getting tiring without someone to rein me in, though. Just once, it’d be nice to have to pull a sleigh instead of unwrapping presents.
lines.zh: 不过,没有人管着我,这种节日里的哀叹开始让人厌倦了。哪怕只有一次,要是能去拉雪橇,而不是拆礼物,那该多好。

lines.en: So while I sneak my way over to the corner of a room where things are finally wrapping up, I think to myself about gifts. How there are many people I know who possess them without having even been given any.
lines.zh: 于是,当我悄悄挪到一个终于快要散场的房间的角落时,我脑子里想的是天赋。我认识很多人,他们身怀天赋,却从未被赠予过任何东西。

lines.en: I think I used to be one of them. That’s what I was told at least. That I was special. That I was talented. But it became harder to take those words seriously once {i}I{/i} was taken.
lines.zh: 我想我曾经也是其中之一。至少别人是这么告诉我的。说我特别。说我有天分。可等{i}我{/i}被人夺走之后,这些话就越来越难当真了。

lines.en: What if I was never gifted at all? What if those words were there to soften my flesh so someone could sink their teeth in? What if that’s what {i}I{/i} did to her?
lines.zh: 万一我从来就没有任何天赋呢?万一那些话只是为了把我的肉泡软,好让别人能把牙咬进来?万一{i}我{/i}对她做的就是这个?
: 就是这样的,对吧?

lines.en: Little by little, the details are coming back to me. But I still can’t recall where things even {i}began{/i} with Maya.
lines.zh: 一点一点地,那些细节正在回到我脑子里。可我依然想不起来,我和 Maya 之间的一切究竟是从哪里{i}开始{/i}的。

lines.en: I know I was her tutor. I know it happened early. And I know I was probably fucked up at the time from losing someone else, but...how bad {i}was{/i} it?
lines.zh: 我知道我是她的家庭教师。我知道那事发生得很早。我也知道,当时我大概因为失去了另一个人而状态糟糕透顶,可是……{i}到底{/i}有多糟?

lines.en: Was what we had really “love” at all? Because she thinks it was and, despite how wrong she’s been about practically everything ever, I can’t help but trust her when it comes to {i}that.{/i}
lines.zh: 我们之间拥有的,真的是「爱」吗?因为她认为是,而尽管她几乎在任何事情上都错得离谱,唯独在{i}这件事{/i}上,我忍不住相信她。

lines.en: Maybe I just want to, though...
lines.zh: 不过,也许只是我想相信而已……

lines.en: Look at me — once more spending thoughts on that irrefutably {i}abnormal{/i} teenage girl while someone else cleans my every trace out of them.
lines.zh: 看看我——又在为那个无可辩驳地{i}不正常{/i}的少女花费心思,而另一个人正把我在她脑海里的每一丝痕迹清理干净。

lines.en: Yet, I remain hopelessly unsatisfied. Because, despite what I tell myself, no amount of sex will ever make me feel the way she did.
lines.zh: 然而,我依然无可救药地不满足。因为不管我怎么对自己说,再多的性爱也永远不会给我她曾经给我的那种感觉。

lines.en: I think they call it “post-nut clarity” or something along that line nowadays. But you’d think that with how often I’m doing that, things would be...I don’t know. A little less blurry?
lines.zh: 我想现在的人管这叫「射后清醒」之类的。不过按说我干得这么频繁,事情总该……我不知道。稍微不那么模糊一点?

lines.en: There are only a few things I know for sure, but an endless amount of things I’ve accepted that I will never understand.
lines.zh: 我确定的事情只有寥寥几件,而我已经接受自己永远无法理解的事情,却多得没有尽头。

lines.en: The first of which has been explained to me many times — it’s the way floating dust particles manage to shimmer and glow when hit at the correct angle by light.
lines.zh: 其中第一件已经被人向我解释过很多遍——是那些漂浮的尘埃,在被光以正确的角度照射时,是如何闪烁发亮的。

lines.en: How something invisible to the naked eye can be {i}made{/i} visible by pure electromagnetic radiation...or something like that.
lines.zh: 肉眼看不到的东西,是怎么被纯粹的电磁辐射……之类的东西{i}变得{/i}可见的。

lines.en: {size=-5}The second thing is the romanticization of death — and how there are people who speak of it with such fervor that a single fatality appears to bring them more joy than the unwrapping of presents on Christmas morning.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-5}第二件事是对死亡的浪漫化——有些人谈起它来如此狂热,以至于一条人命死去,给他们带来的快乐似乎比圣诞早晨拆开礼物还要多。{/size}

lines.en: The third is that secret magnets have been implanted inside of Maya and me that do nothing but cause me to feel sick to my stomach whenever she’s close by.
lines.zh: 第三件事是,Maya 和我体内被植入了秘密的磁铁,它们唯一的作用就是:只要她一靠近,我就胃里难受。

lines.en: And she’s close by now. I felt her enter the room a minute ago.
lines.zh: 而她现在就在附近。一分钟前我就感觉到她进了房间。

lines.en: I don’t even have to look. I just {i}know.{/i} And I {i}hate{/i} that I know because {i}this{/i} one isn’t {i}her.{/i} I {i}shouldn’t{/i} know.
lines.zh: 我甚至不用看。我就是{i}知道{/i}。而我{i}讨厌{/i}自己知道,因为{i}这一个{/i}并不是{i}她{/i}。我本{i}不该{/i}知道的。

lines.en: But she still has her magnet. Which means my stomach still hurts. And there’s no one I can ask for help that won’t just make me feel worse.
lines.zh: 可她身上依然有那块磁铁。也就是说我的胃依然在疼。而没有一个我能求助的人,不会只是让我感觉更糟。

lines.en: That’s one of the problems with being liked — never having to do things on your own. Always having a fall-back for when things get tough.
lines.zh: 这就是被人喜欢的问题之一——永远不必靠自己去做事。遇到难关时,永远有个退路。

lines.en: Sometimes, I feel like I’d be a much better person today if I just locked myself inside of a room after Sekai died and let my muscles atrophy {i}without{/i} Ami there to watch.
lines.zh: 有时候我觉得,如果 Sekai 死后我干脆把自己锁在一间屋子里,在{i}没有{/i} Ami 看着的情况下让肌肉慢慢萎缩,今天的我会是个好得多的人。

lines.en: I’d probably be writhing in pain and covered in piss, but at least I’d have kept away from dragging everyone else into an endless hell.
lines.zh: 我大概会痛得在地上打滚、浑身沾满尿,但至少我不会把所有人都拖进一个无尽的地狱。

lines.en: The worst part of all, though, is that I know it won’t end with me. And that one of these girls will follow in my footsteps one day.
lines.zh: 可最糟的是,我知道这事不会在我身上结束。而这些女孩中的某一个,总有一天会步我的后尘。

lines.en: They’ll hurt someone else. They’ll haunt someone else. And that will go on and on and on and on because that’s how this world works. But for once, I’m not talking about time.
lines.zh: 她们会去伤害别人。她们会去纠缠别人。而那会一直、一直、一直地持续下去,因为这个世界就是这么运转的。不过这一次,我说的不是时间。

lines.en: Is there anything I can do to stop it?
lines.zh: 我有什么办法能阻止它吗?

lines.en: Please tell me so I know what not to do.
lines.zh: 请告诉我,好让我知道不该做什么。

lines.en: There it is again — that unending desire to hold something. To {i}be{/i} held.
lines.zh: 又来了——那种想要抓住点什么的、无止境的渴望。想{i}被{/i}抓住。

lines.en: How nice it would be if only she fit in the palm of my hand.
lines.zh: 要是她能刚好被我捧在手心里,该有多好。
: 你现在恨我了吗?
: 不。我不{i}恨{/i}你。

lines.en: : Well, it feels like you do. And I won’t {i}blame{/i} you if you do after that stuff I said about Niki.
lines.zh: : 嗯,可感觉你就是恨我。而且就凭我说的那些关于 Niki 的话,你要是真恨我,我也不会{i}怪{/i}你。

lines.en: : You don’t like her. I get it. That won’t make me hate you, though. It’d take a lot more than that.
lines.zh: : 你不喜欢她。我理解。不过这还不至于让我恨你。要恨你,得比这严重得多。

lines.en: : Like what? Stealing the body of your one true love?
lines.zh: : 比如什么?比如偷走你唯一真爱的身体?
: 我……我不是那个意思。

lines.en: : I...get nervous and...{i}mean{/i} when I have to...talk about stuff. And I guess that...
lines.zh: : 我……一谈到这些事就会……紧张,然后……变得{i}刻薄{/i}。我想,那个……

lines.en: : I guess that what I’m trying to say is...if being around me really {i}is{/i} causing you pain, I’m...sorry.
lines.zh: : 我想,我想说的是……如果和我在一起{i}真的{/i}让你痛苦,那我……很抱歉。

lines.en: : I’m sorry for...following you and...I’m sorry for forcing you to talk to me and...have sex with me and...all of that stuff that makes {i}me{/i} feel better. But from {i}my{/i} perspective-
lines.zh: : 我为……跟着你道歉……我为逼你和我说话道歉……逼你和我上床道歉……为所有这些只是让{i}我自己{/i}好受的事道歉。不过从{i}我的{/i}角度来看——

lines.en: : I know what it’s like from your perspective. You don’t have to tell me.
lines.zh: : 我知道从你的角度看是什么样。你不用告诉我。

lines.en: : It’s not {i}your{/i} fault this happened, it’s mine. And holding that against you isn’t doing either one of us any good apparently.
lines.zh: : 发生这种事不是{i}你的{/i}错,是我的错。而把这件事怪到你头上,显然对我们两个谁都没好处。
: 我……{i}真的{/i}想搞明白……Akira。
: 关于……{i}我自己{/i}。

lines.en: : As fucking...inconceivable as it is, it’s become...{i}glaringly{/i} clear to me that some things about this place and...about {i}us{/i} are...not even close to the way they seem.
lines.zh: : 尽管这他妈的……难以置信,但我已经……{i}清清楚楚地{/i}意识到,关于这个地方、关于{i}我们{/i}的一些事情……和它们看上去的样子差了十万八千里。

lines.en: : But I don’t know {i}how{/i} they became like that or...how long they’ve been that way. Or when they’ll go back. Or {i}if{/i} they’ll go back...
lines.zh: : 可我不知道它们是{i}怎么{/i}变成那样的,也不知道……它们那样多久了。或者它们什么时候会变回去。或者它们到底{i}会不会{/i}变回去……
: 可我{i}想{/i}知道。

lines.en: : The fact that I never gave up on you must count for {i}something,{/i} right? Because that’s still {i}me.{/i} That’s what {i}I’m{/i} bound to turn into if things stay like this forever.
lines.zh: : 我从来没有放弃过你,这一点总该{i}有些分量{/i}吧?因为那依然是{i}我{/i}。如果事情永远这样下去,那就是{i}我{/i}注定会变成的样子。
: 如果不是呢?……

lines.en: : What happens if you get sent back again? Or what happens if {i}I{/i} get sent back again? Are we really just going to keep hurting each other for the rest of our infinite existence? Is {i}that{/i} what we have to do?
lines.zh: : 如果你又被送回去了怎么办?或者如果{i}我{/i}被送回去了怎么办?我们真的要在这无尽的存在的余下部分里,一直互相伤害下去吗?{i}那{/i}就是我们非做不可的事吗?
: 可那……也不{i}只{/i}是痛苦,对吧?
: 你就从来没有……和我在一起时感到{i}幸福{/i}过吗?

lines.en: : Are there really...{i}no{/i} moments at all that you look back on and think, “this is what makes the pain worth it?”
lines.zh: : 真的……一个瞬间都{i}没有{/i}吗?让你回想起来会觉得「就是因为这些,那些痛苦才值得」的瞬间?

lines.en: : Something...something...blah, blah, blah...this isn’t {i}supposed{/i} to be easy or...whatever.
lines.zh: : 什么……什么……吧啦吧啦吧啦……这本来就{i}不该{/i}是容易的事,或者……随便吧。

lines.en: : Do you want to know what you’ll turn into if you stay like this?
lines.zh: : 你想知道,如果你一直这样下去,会变成什么样吗?

lines.en: : A cruel, manipulative, over-protective, gaslighting bitch who refuses to listen to anyone but herself. Someone who’d stab even her best friend in the back in exchange for the {i}slightest{/i} hint of personal progression.
lines.zh: : 一个残忍、善于操控、过度保护、还爱洗脑的婊子,除了她自己,谁的话都不听。一个哪怕只为了{i}一丝一毫{/i}的个人进展,也肯在背后捅自己最好的朋友一刀的人。

lines.en: : Someone incessantly incorrigible, who does nothing but mock and belittle everyone around her from the top of some pedestal she created out of hers and everyone else’s broken dreams and unrealized desires.
lines.zh: : 一个无可救药到了极点的人,只会站在某个她用自己和别人破碎的梦想、未竟的欲望垒起的神坛上,嘲弄和贬低身边的每一个人。

lines.en: : Someone so closed off that, even when the man she’s been chasing after for an indeterminate amount of time shows up, it takes her {i}years{/i} to even realize it.
lines.zh: : 一个封闭到这种程度的人:即便那个她追了不知道多久的男人出现在眼前,她也要花上{i}好几年{/i}才意识到。

lines.en: : And even {i}then,{/i} she’s someone so self-absorbed, yet so fucking {i}cowardly{/i} that it takes her even longer to {i}do{/i} anything about it.
lines.zh: : 而即便到了{i}那时{/i},她依然是个如此自我中心、却又他妈的如此{i}怯懦{/i}的人,要花更久的时间才能采取任何行动。

lines.en: : Maybe she was right about that part, though. I did effectively {i}kill{/i} her after all. But that just goes to show that {i}I{/i} suck too — which is something both of us are already well aware of.
lines.zh: : 不过,也许那部分她说对了。我毕竟确实等于{i}杀{/i}了她。可这恰恰说明{i}我{/i}也很烂——而这一点我们两个早就心知肚明。
: 是啊……

lines.en: : We’ve both been pretty shitty from the get-go, huh?
lines.zh: : 我们两个从一开始就都挺烂的,对吧?

lines.en: : Except I don’t know the first thing about how you even {i}got{/i} that way, so I just have to assume it was me who did it to you.
lines.zh: : 只不过我对你究竟是怎么{i}变成{/i}这样的完全一无所知,所以我只能假定,是我把你弄成这样的。

lines.en: : You never told me anything about your past...About where you came from or...even any specific details about how we met and our time together.
lines.zh: : 你从来没跟我讲过你的过去……你从哪里来……甚至没有讲过我们是怎么认识的、以及我们在一起的时光里的任何具体细节。

lines.en: : Back when it was the {i}other{/i} you, I could easily just chalk that up to be something like, “Oh, she’s just trying to protect me.” Or, “This might fuck my brain up in some weird sort of way.”
lines.zh: : 在还是「{i}另一个{/i}你」的时候,我很容易就能把它归结成类似「哦,她只是想保护我」或者「这可能会以某种奇怪的方式把我的脑子搞坏」这样的理由。

lines.en: : But I also feel like {i}you{/i} won’t tell me either, and you don’t know the first thing about all of that time-fuckery stuff. You’re just...not the type of girl who likes to share, I think.
lines.zh: : 可我也觉得{i}你{/i}同样不会告诉我,而你对那些时间乱七八糟的事一窍不通。你只是……不是那种喜欢分享的女孩,我想。

lines.en: : Neither are you. I always had to figure out everything out on my own. But that’s why we worked so well.
lines.zh: : 你也不是。我什么都只能自己弄明白。可正因为如此,我们才那么合拍。

lines.en: : We could be with each other and...touch each other and...and {i}that{/i} would be enough. We didn’t need to talk. And...I think that’s fine. I don’t have much else to give anyway.
lines.zh: : 我们只要和彼此在一起……触碰彼此……{i}那{/i}就够了。我们不需要说话。而且……我觉得那样挺好。反正我也没有别的东西可以给了。

lines.en: : There it is again. Textbook Maya — closing me out despite having her leash wrapped around my neck.
lines.zh: : 又来了。教科书式的 Maya——明明把牵引绳缠在我脖子上,却还是把我关在门外。
: 不是的,Akira。我……我真的不{i}记得{/i}了。

lines.en: : {i}You,{/i} I remember! That part is super clear. {i}Graphic,{/i} yes. But clear as day.
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i},我记得!那部分特别清楚。是很{i}露骨{/i},没错。但清清楚楚。
: 是……在你{i}之前{/i}的那部分……{i}消失了{/i}。

lines.en: : That sounds a lot like me for the first several years of this...reincarnation or whatever you want to call it. Maybe not as bad, though. I didn’t even know my name at first.
lines.zh: : 这听起来很像我在这场……转生,或者随便你叫它什么的前几年。不过也许没那么严重。我一开始连自己的名字都不知道。

lines.en: : Well, I definitely know that. It’s really just...everything from {i}before{/i} we met that feels...blank. Like that part of my life was just never filled in or something.
lines.zh: : 嗯,那个我当然知道。真的只是……我们相遇{i}之前{/i}的一切,感觉……空白。就好像我人生中那一段从来没有被填进去过一样。

lines.en: : Maybe you’re just repressing something? That’s what I was doing.
lines.zh: : 也许你只是在压抑什么?我以前就是那样。

lines.en: : Maybe...But if that’s the case, do you think I’m better off trying to dig it up? Or...
lines.zh: : 也许吧……可如果是这样,你觉得我去把它挖出来会更好吗?还是……

lines.en: : No. Keep it buried. Digging it up won’t do anything but further complicate things and send you spiraling into chaotic debauchery.
lines.zh: : 不。让它埋着。把它挖出来只会让事情更复杂,还会让你一路螺旋跌进混乱的放荡里。

lines.en: : Heh...Chaotic debauchery...sounds kind of fun. Don’t you think? Hahah...hah...
lines.zh: : 嘿……混乱的放荡……听起来还挺有意思的。你不觉得吗?哈哈……哈……
: 听着……
: 我的,呃……

lines.en: : My birthday is coming up soon and...
lines.zh: : 我的生日快到了,然后……

lines.en: : And there’s this...festival I want to go to.
lines.zh: : 还有个……我想去的节日庆典。

lines.en: : I, like...get that things are kind of...{i}weird{/i} with us right now. But I...
lines.zh: : 我,那个……知道我们现在之间有点……{i}怪怪的{/i}。可我……

lines.en: : If you, like...wanted to go with me-
lines.zh: : 如果你,那个……想和我一起去的话——
: 抱歉……

lines.en: : I don’t think that’s...a good idea...
lines.zh: : 我觉得那……不是个好主意……
: 我只是……

lines.en: : I can...go some other year or...
lines.zh: : 我可以……改年再去,或者……
: 这不是针对你……我只是……
: 我是和{i}她{/i}一起去的,而且……

lines.en: : We can...do something {i}else{/i} though. Like...maybe not for your birthday, but...
lines.zh: : 不过我们可以……做点{i}别的{/i}。比如……也许不在你生日那天,不过……
: 我们可以……我不知道……去吃……晚饭?

lines.en: : You’ll spend time with me again?...
lines.zh: : 你愿意再和我待在一起了?……
: 哪怕会痛?……

lines.en: : I’ve been...holding things against you, that...I probably shouldn’t.
lines.zh: : 我一直在……拿一些事怪你,那些事……我大概不该怪。

lines.en: : So if there’s anything you have in mind-
lines.zh: : 所以如果你心里有什么想法——
: 还有……{i}一件{/i}事。
: 嗯……是什么?
: 最近……有点冷……
: 不是吗?

lines.en: : I think I...might need to buy...heavier clothes or...something like that.
lines.zh: : 我想我……可能需要买……厚一点的衣服,或者……类似的东西。
: 我们可以……一起去?
: 我们可以去。
: 太……太好了!嗯……
: 这是……呃……算约会吗?

lines.en: : We can just...hang out. It doesn’t have to-
lines.zh: : 我们就……一起出去玩。不一定要——

lines.en: : Yeah! Th-That’s what I was gonna say.
lines.zh: : 对!我——我本来也是这么说的。
: 那就……

lines.en: We remain right there until we’re the only two left.
lines.zh: 我们就那样待在原地,直到只剩下我们两个。

lines.en: It’s just like when the world was ending.
lines.zh: 就像世界末日的时候一样。
{i}Maya 的好感度提升到了 [maya_love]!{/i}

lines.en: {i}It appears that you’re ready to talk to her again!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}看来你已经准备好再和她说话了!{/i}

lines.en: {i}Don’t get {b}too{/b} close, though! You saw what happened last time!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}不过别靠{b}太{/b}近!你看到上次发生什么了!{/i}

lines.en: {i}But if it still feels wrong, maybe getting closer is for the best after all?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}可如果那感觉依然不对,也许靠得更近才是最好的?{/i}

lines.en: {i}Is another taste of her forbidden fruit so tantalizing that you’d risk damning humanity to fill your stomach?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}再尝一口她的禁果,真的诱人到值得你冒着把全人类都诅咒一遍的风险去填饱自己的肚子吗?{/i}

lines.en: {i}You have many things to figure out about yourself! About what you want! About where to go!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你有很多关于自己的事要搞清楚!关于你想要什么!关于你该去哪儿!{/i}

lines.en: {i}And there’s no one around to hold you back any longer.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}而且身边再也没有人能拦着你了。{/i}
{i}你自由了。{/i}

lines.en: {i}You can eat as much fruit as you want.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你想吃多少果子就吃多少。{/i}
{b}圣诞他妈的快乐{/b}

lines.en: : {i}It’s been...getting kind of cold lately, and...I mean...if you’re not busy...I kind of want to...buy something warmer?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}最近……越来越冷了,而且……我是说……如果你不忙的话……我有点想……去买件暖和点的?{/i}
: {i}我们可以……一起去?如果那——{/i}
: {i}嗯……嗯,我们可以去。我会……{/i}
: {i}我会给你发消息。{/i}

lines.en: : Dear, Touka — I sincerely apologize for ducking out early. But, after much consideration, I realized that the likelihood of Sensei making love to me tonight was very low and-
lines.zh: : 亲爱的 Touka——我为由早退真诚道歉。不过,经过深思熟虑,我意识到今晚 Sensei 和我云雨的可能性非常低,而且——
: 圣诞快乐。
: 你是……
: 有什么……
: 你以为你了解我?
: 不是吗?……
: 真了不起……

lines.en: : No wonder I’m so talented and cool.
lines.zh: : 难怪我这么有才华、这么酷。

lines.en: : Hey, it’s kind of cold out here.
lines.zh: : 嘿,外面有点冷。

lines.en: : Would you mind if I maybe...you know.
lines.zh: : 你介不介意我,那个……你知道的。
: ……我的围巾?

lines.en: : It’s not important to you, is it?
lines.zh: : 它对你来说不重要吧?

lines.en: : Huh?...No! No, I don’t mind. Yeah. You can have it.
lines.zh: : 啊?……不!不,我不介意。嗯。给你了。

lines.en: : Do you...want me to call you a cab? Or...is there anything {i}else{/i} I can do to-
lines.zh: : 你……要我帮你叫辆车吗?或者……{i}还{/i}有什么我能——
: 现在只要围巾就行。

lines.en: : If there’s anything else, I’ll let you know.
lines.zh: : 如果还有别的,我会告诉你的。

lines.en: : And so she handed that old winter garment over to the girl — its nostalgic scent still clinging to each and every fiber.
lines.zh: : 于是她把那件旧冬装递给了那个女孩——那股让人怀念的气味,依然附着在每一根纤维上。

lines.en: : There was a thought...a minor one...that perhaps things could still work out if she kept it for herself. As a memento, of sorts.
lines.zh: : 她有过一个念头……一个很小的念头……如果她自己留着,也许事情还会有转机。当作某种纪念品。

lines.en: : That was all it was, though. A thought. And a fleeting one at that. Because...
lines.zh: : 不过那也只是个念头而已。一个念头。而且还是转瞬即逝的。因为……

lines.en: : Whether she liked it or not...
lines.zh: : 不管她喜不喜欢……
: 好戏开场了。
{i}Maya 的好感度提升到了 [maya_love]!{/i}
